subject: Orion Health renewal & commitment top‑up — procurement timeline and docs
messages:
From: Jenna Li <jenna.li@orionhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commitment top‑up & renewal timing (Orion Health)

Hi Kim —

We’re planning to increase our annual commitment for the next 12‑month period to cover the new clinical routing pipelines (estimate +40% token volume). Procurement asked for a private offer through AWS Marketplace so they can issue a consolidated PO. Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can add the uplift to the existing private offer (same account) or if we need a new PO; 2) estimated lead time for legal review + DocuSign; and 3) whether you can split billing into two tranches that align with our fiscal quarters?

We’d like to finalize by end of July to hit our internal approval window. Attaching a rough usage projection.

Thanks,
Jenna Li
Head of Cloud Procurement
Orion Health

----
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Jenna Li <jenna.li@orionhealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commitment top‑up & renewal timing (Orion Health)

Hi Jenna —

Thanks — we can accommodate a +40% uplift on the existing private offer (same AWS account) without creating a new listing. High‑level plan:
- Legal review and DocuSign: target 7–10 business days once we have signed PO + any redlines.
- Billing tranches: yes, we support split invoices (we’ll mirror to your fiscal quarters). We’ll surface the split in the invoice metadata so it can be consumed by your ERP.
- Onboarding: small usage migration not required — this is capacity/commitment only.

To move forward please: 1) send the PO to procurement@redwood.ai (see template attached), 2) confirm if accounting needs a vendor W‑9, and 3) indicate preferred tranche dates. I’ll loop in our billing and marketplace leads.

I’ll follow up with internal next steps.

Best,
Kim Park
Head of Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orion_PO_template_2026.pdf

----
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orion Health commitment top‑up — billing tranche suggestion

Kim / Rafael —

Quick internal note after reading Jenna’s ask: procurement wants two tranches aligned to Q3 and Q4. Proposed split: 60% upfront (effective on acceptance), 40% at start of Q4. For Marketplace private offers we can map the invoice dates but need to ensure AWS PO references the private offer ID so billing reconciles.

Action items for us:
- Rafael: generate updated PrivateOffer_Agreement_v3 with clause that allows staged billing and the effective commitment increase date.
- Kim: confirm the DocuSign powerform link for Orion and whether we should route first sign to AWS Marketplace AM for visibility.
- Finance: confirm whether we can accept a single consolidated PO with two invoice dates; if not, we’ll need two POs.

I’ll draft the procurement_checklist_orion.xlsx for internal handoff.

— Priyom
Principal Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

----
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orion Health commitment top‑up — billing tranche suggestion

Priyom / Kim —

Got it. I’ve updated the agreement to include: staged billing language, effective date tie to acceptance, and an AWS PO reference field. Draft highlights:
- Section 2.1: commitment increase applies to same Private Offer ID; no new listing required.
- Section 6.2: invoices may be issued on two dates per customer request; acceptance defined as DocuSign completion.
- Appendix A: billing metadata sample for AWS reconciliation.

I’ve attached the PrivateOffer_Agreement_v3.docx and procurement_checklist_orion.xlsx. Rafael (legal) to coordinate final redlines with our commercial counsel — target turnaround 5 business days.

Rgds,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Contracts Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PrivateOffer_Agreement_v3.docx, procurement_checklist_orion.xlsx

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Jenna Li <jenna.li@orionhealth.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@orionhealth.com>, AWS Marketplace AM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Orion Health private offer top‑up — next steps and links

Jenna / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirming the plan below and next steps so everyone has a single source of truth:

Plan summary
- Commitment: +40% to current 12‑month private offer (same AWS account).
- Billing: 60% upfront on acceptance; 40% invoiced at start of Q4. We will reflect tranche dates in the invoice metadata.
- Legal: Redwood to issue updated Private Offer Agreement (attached).
- Timeline: DocuSign and legal turnaround estimate 5–10 business days after PO submission; target completion by 30 July.

Required from Orion
1) Signed PO (use attached template) or two POs if procurement prefers separate documents for each tranche.
2) Vendor information for accounting (W‑9 or tax docs).
3) Any redlines to the attached agreement within 48 hours of receipt.

Action owners
- Jenna / Orion: send PO to procurement@redwood.ai and confirm tranche dates.
- AWS AM: please note the Private Offer ID RDW-PO-2219 when processing in marketplace.
- Rafael: finalize agreement; Kim will send DocuSign link once Rafael gives the go‑ahead.
- Marissa: billing ops to prepare invoice schedule template for Orion.

Attachments: PrivateOffer_Agreement_v3.docx, Orion_PO_template_2026.pdf, procurement_checklist_orion.xlsx

If that looks right I’ll open the DocuSign envelope and loop the AWS AM as FYI.

Best,
Kim Park
Head of Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
